title: Nextflow task hash spec schema
description: Schema for a task hash version: which keys are hashed, in what order, how each value is encoded, and which lineage record fields carry each key

id.description: Identifier of this task hash version, e.g. std/v1.7

note.description: What changed in this version, and which commit ended it

function.description: Hash function applied to the key values

keys.description: The hashed keys, in the order they are fed to the hash function

encoding.description: How values are serialised before hashing. Two versions can share a key set and still hash differently, so these are part of the version

orderIndependentMaps.description: Hash a map by its entry set rather than by its values

cacheFunnelFirst.description: Let an object hash itself before any other rule applies

assetRootDetection.description: Treat a file under the assets root as a repository asset, not only one under the base directory

contributor.description: Identifier of the code that produces this key's value

lineage.description: Fields of the lineage TaskRun record that carry this key. An empty list means the key is not recorded, and a consumer must report it as unseen rather than as unchanged
